title: Pickleheads - Play Pickleball
description:
Dive into the world of pickleball with Pickleheads, the easiest way to find and organize games!

Discover Courts Near You: With over 16,000 locations in the US, Canada, and worldwide, you're never far from a court. Pickleheads has the most extensive and accurate directory of places to play pickleball. Our community-driven directory makes it easy to find a nearby court.

Find Nearby Games: Easily find games tailored to your skill level. We bring together play schedules from every city, so you're always in the loop.

Join Groups: Become a part of local pickleball groups, chat with other players, and get invited to play.

Effortless Scheduling: Organize a game in seconds with our free tools. Invite players, manage sign-ups, handle waitlists, collect payments and more. 

Learn & Improve: Whether you're just starting out or looking to refine your skills, we constantly post guides to improve your game.

Create private lists of players and invite them to play in a few taps.

releaseNotes:
Version 3.2.0
New Popcorn
Every round robin now uses New Popcorn. Set your round count up front and it plans all the matchups at once, so partners and opponents stay fresh. Look ahead at any round to see partners, courts, and who's sitting out. Don't like a matchup? Tap EDIT before the round starts and swap anyone in.

Leaderboard milestones
Hit the top 10, the top 3, or #1 and you'll get a card on your home screen and a push. Tap it to go straight to the board.

Share your rank
Leaderboard pages have a share button now. It builds an image with your rank, your stats, and the board details. Group chat fodder.

Version 3.1.x
Check-in mode. Players check in when they arrive so organizers know
who's actually there before generating matchups.

Spectator links and QR codes. Follow matchups, live standings, and the
bracket without joining the game.

Simplify onboarding by automatically adding players to one of your groups.

See your group games on the home screen. You can now customize the
Find Games section to show games from groups you're in.

Plus 24 other bug fixes and performance improvements throughout the app!

------
Previous versions
Version 3.0.4
Spectator mode! Every round robin now has a spectator link in the invite panel, with a QR code option too. Anyone who opens it can follow the matchups, live standings, and bracket as they happen, without joining as a player. Perfect for mini tournaments, leagues, or friends and family who just want to watch.
Version 3.0.3
Court leaderboards ΓÇö see how you stack up at your favorite courts! New leaderboards rank players by wins, games, points, and point differential, with weekly, monthly, and all-time views. Play in any session at a court and you're on the board.

Hidden sessions ΓÇö Pro and Ultra organizers get a new visibility option beyond public and private. Hidden sessions stay off the map, search, and court calendars entirely ΓÇö only players you invite or share the link with can find them.
Version 3.0.1

Version 3.0.0
Our biggest update yet ΓÇö Pickleheads has been updated from the ground up for a faster, more reliable app!
Introducing Rumble, our newest fixed-partner format. Keep the same partner all session while our seeding engine matches you against teams at your level ΓÇö win and you'll climb into tougher matchups, lose and you'll get an easier draw.
